name: SASSA Pretoria (Head Office)
address: SASSA House, 501 Prodinsa Building, Cnr Steve Biko and Pretorius Streets
description: The SASSA Head Office in Pretoria is the central hub for policy and grant administration. It handles complex appeals and national-level inquiries.
localTips: Arrive before 7:00 AM as queues form early.
Bring original documents and at least 2 certified copies.
The office is close to public transport on Steve Biko Road.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Johannesburg Regional Office
description: Serving the heart of Gauteng, the Braamfontein office is one of the busiest SASSA service points, specializing in SRD and disability grants.
localTips: Park at nearby secure lots in Braamfontein; street parking is risky.
Check the queue for 'New Applications' vs 'Status Queries' as they move at different speeds.
Tuesdays and Wednesdays are generally less crowded than Mondays.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Cape Town (Golden Acre)
description: Located conveniently in the Golden Acre Mall, this office provides easy access for residents in the Cape Town CBD and surrounding suburbs.
localTips: Enter via the Adderley Street entrance for fastest access to the SASSA floor.
Highly accessible via Metrorail and MyCiti bus systems.
Peak times are usually between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Durban (Regional)
description: While the regional HQ is in PMB, the Durban service points are critical for KZN beneficiaries. This office coordinates mobile units for rural areas.
localTips: If the main office is full, ask about mobile outreach schedules for your township.
Ensure your cellphone is fully charged as you may need to receive an OTP during your visit.
Staff are fluent in isiZulu and English.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Bloemfontein Office
address: Cnr St. Andrew Street & Aliwal Street
description: The central office for the Free State, providing comprehensive support for Child Support, Disability, and Old Age grants.
localTips: The office is centrally located near the Bloemfontein Magistrate Court.
Queue management is generally efficient, but bring a bottle of water for the wait.
Ask for a reference number before leaving the counter.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Polokwane Office
description: Limpopo's primary SASSA hub, managing a high volume of agricultural and rural grant applications.
localTips: Arrive early if traveling from outside Polokwane city limits.
The office is within walking distance of the main taxi rank.
Check that your bank statements are stamped by your bank before arrival.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Mbombela (Nelspruit)
description: Serving the Mpumalanga region, this office is key for beneficiaries in the Lowveld area.
localTips: Avoid visiting on the first two days of the month when grant payments start.
Bring a pen to fill out forms while waiting in the queue.
Parking is available but fills up by 8:30 AM.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Kimberley Office
description: The main Northern Cape office, located in the historic 'Perm' building in Kimberley.
localTips: The office is in the city center; very easy to find.
Queue for 'Old Age' grants usually has a dedicated shorter line.
Verify your banking details at the 'Info' desk before joining the main queue.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA East London Office
address: BKB Building, Cnr Fitzpatrick & Merino Road, Quigney
description: A vital service point for the Buffalo City Metropolitan Municipality in the Eastern Cape.
localTips: The Quigney area can be windy; dress warmly if waiting outside.
Secure your ID and phone while in the queue.
The office is close to the East London harbor area.
source: Official SASSA contact pages (sassa.gov.za) & SA Government directory

name: SASSA Soweto Office
description: One of the most essential offices in Gauteng, serving the large community of Soweto. Street-level contact details for this branch are not published by SASSA — confirm the nearest service point with the national helpline 0800 60 10 11 before travelling.
localTips: This office experiences very high traffic; consider visiting the Maponya Mall branch if queues are excessive.
Many staff speak multiple local languages including isiZulu, Sesotho, and English.
Check your status online first to see if a physical visit is truly necessary.
